verdict.rationale: ADK explicitly supports multi-agent orchestration: workflows are defined as any application with more than one agent/node, with a graph-based Workflow Runtime supporting routing, fan-out/fan-in, loops, nested workflows, and a Task API for structured agent-to-agent delegation including multi-turn task mode and mixed delegation patterns; the CLI/Web UI explicitly supports multi-agent directories. missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on validation of complex multi-agent orchestration at scale.
